pretreatments.description: Chemical Pretreatment using Peracetic Acid (PAA) solution containing 10% PAA, 14% H2O2, and 25% acetic acid by weight. The process involved stirring at 450 rpm for 30 minutes at 25°C, followed by incubation at 35 ± 1°C. Dosages were tested at 0, 1, 2, 3, and 4 mM/g VS, with N2 aeration for 20 min.
